enabled.label: Body Auras on
enabled.description: Off: no auras on minions, pets, totems, traps, mines or you from this mod (the Body Aura cosmetics stay in the Cosmetics tab while the mod's content is applied).

spectres.label: What your spectres wear
spectres.description: off, character (what your character wears in the Character Effect slot: a body aura or a character effect), or an aura: its key or name (/aura list in the game shows them, e.g. crucible).

spectreLook.label: How spectres wear it
spectreLook.description: replace: in place of their see-through spectral look, as the game's spectre skins do (clearest). add: on top of the spectral look (fainter).

everything.label: What every other minion wears
everything.description: Zombies, skeletons, raging spirits, phantasms, golems, skitterbots, reapers, animated weapons and guardians, relics, spiders, wolves, clones and the rest, unless a kind has its own below. off, character (what your character wears in the Character Effect slot: a body aura or a character effect), or an aura: its key or name (/aura list in the game shows them, e.g. crucible).

perKind.label: A minion kind's own aura (kind: aura)
perKind.description: Over "every other minion", e.g. "ragingspirit": "crucible", "zombie": "off". /aura kinds in the game lists the kinds you have summoned.

whenCharacterHasNone.label: "character" when your character wears no aura
whenCharacterHasNone.description: What anything set to "character" wears while your Character Effect slot is empty (or holds a character effect without a minion look). off, character (what your character wears in the Character Effect slot: a body aura or a character effect), or an aura: its key or name (/aura list in the game shows them, e.g. crucible).

pets.label: What your pets wear
pets.description: off, character (what your character wears in the Character Effect slot: a body aura or a character effect), or an aura: its key or name (/aura list in the game shows them, e.g. crucible).

totems.label: What your totems wear
totems.description: off, character (what your character wears in the Character Effect slot: a body aura or a character effect), or an aura: its key or name (/aura list in the game shows them, e.g. crucible).

traps.label: What your traps wear
traps.description: off, character (what your character wears in the Character Effect slot: a body aura or a character effect), or an aura: its key or name (/aura list in the game shows them, e.g. crucible).

mines.label: What your mines wear
mines.description: off, character (what your character wears in the Character Effect slot: a body aura or a character effect), or an aura: its key or name (/aura list in the game shows them, e.g. crucible).

extra.label: An aura besides your character effect
extra.description: Wear an aura on top of whatever is in your Character Effect slot (it can be another character effect): off, or an aura's key or name. For just one, wear its Body Aura in the Cosmetics tab instead.

ownedOnly.label: Only auras you own
ownedOnly.description: With Cosmetic Drops locking cosmetics: an aura is used only once your account owns its cosmetic (a body aura, or the character effect). Body auras drop where their weapon effects do. Owning a body aura does not give you its weapon effect.

updateSeconds.label: How often minions are checked
updateSeconds.description: A new minion, pet, totem, trap or mine gets its aura within this time.

commands.label: The /aura command
commands.description: /aura shows the choices; /aura list [words] lists the auras; /aura kinds the minion kinds; /aura <spectres|minions|pets|totems|traps|mines|me|a kind> <off|character|default|aura> changes one for the character you play (data/moddata/bodyauras/aura-choices.json).
